i18n.distribution.mediatype.popover.desc: A media type, also known as a MIME type, describes the type of content of a medium. It consists of a main type and a subtype. These are separated by a slash. Examples: a table in CSV format is described with "text/csv", a web page in HTML with "text/html". The specification of the media type is used to determine how content is to be interpreted and processed. Such specifications are used by the web browser or e-mail program, for example.
